Controls are straightforward: Still working on this one O_O You can jump in immediately, but it becomes more rewarding as you start reading the flow and making cleaner decisions. In Champion Island, you’ll often balance speed and accuracy—pushing forward to gain progress while avoiding mistakes that end a run or set you back.
